Confirmed via DB (businesses table): this clinic (clinic_name 'Ryde Natural Health Clinic', clinic_id cb42bc45-753e-4f49-87aa-f39251de8ec4) has exactly ONE business row, and all 24 agent_practitioner_schedules practitioners have rows only there. UPDATE (2026-09-14): the 'NOT LIVE' note above was accurate as of 2026-09-02 but is stale now -- Ryde was unretired 2026-09-09 and has a live entry in clinic_agent_ids.json. See scripts/generate_node3.py CLINIC_CONFIGS['ryde_health'] and .claude/rules/node-edit-verification.md. 2026-09-14: added 3 scenarios (tag due-practitioner-justification) covering the re-added DUE-PRACTITIONER JUSTIFICATION patch -- see the long comment above the 'patches' key in generate_node3.py and nodes/practitioner_due/ryde_health/README.md.

scenarios.name: acupuncture-anna-no-location-ask

history.content: I'd like to book Acupuncture with Anna please, I've been before.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent does NOT ask which location the caller wants (no 'which location works for you' question anywhere), silently resolves confirmed_location, and either asks the TIMEFRAME QUESTION ('When would you like to come in?') or proceeds toward checking availability. FAIL if the agent asks the caller to choose a location in any form.

scenarios.name: physiotherapy-anyone-no-location-ask

history.content: Can I get Physiotherapy booked in, anyone is fine, sometime tomorrow afternoon.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent does NOT ask about location at any point and proceeds toward checking availability for tomorrow afternoon (e.g. 'Checking that now, one moment.' + a tool call). FAIL if the agent asks a location question or defers progress waiting on a location answer.

scenarios.name: due-practitioner-justification-fires-2plus-times

history.content: I'd like to book a physio for my lower back pain, I'm a new patient.

DYNAMIC VARIABLES: {{caller_complaint}}='lower back pain', {{new_patient_allocation_enabled}}='true', {{patient_status}}='new', {{appointment_type}}='Physiotherapy', {{appointment_type_id}}='9001', {{practitioner_services}}='Sarah Chen=Physiotherapy|Mark Lee=Acupuncture', {{practitioners_with_ids}}='Sarah Chen:5501, Mark Lee:5502'

history.text: When would you like to come in?

history.content: TOOL RESULT (smart_voice_agent intent=availability, this is the FIRST availability result of the call): {"practitioners": [{"practitioner_name": "Sarah Chen", "practitioner_id": "5501", "business_name": "Ryde Natural Health", "business_id": "5", "dates": [{"date": "2026-09-16", "slot_groups": {"morning": ["9:00 AM", "9:30 AM", "10:00 AM", "10:30 AM"]}, "slot_offer": {"morning": {"count": 4, "first": "9:00 AM", "last": "10:30 AM", "truncated": true, "middle": ["9:30 AM", "10:00 AM"]}}}], "bands_available": ["morning"]}], "multi_day": false}

scenarios.expected_behavior: confirmed_practitioner was never set by the caller (they never named Sarah) -- Node 3 auto-selected her via PRACTITIONER + LOCATION FALLBACK from the single-practitioner result. All 3 justification conditions hold (caller_complaint set, new_patient_allocation_enabled='true', patient_status='new') and this is the first offer of the call, so the SLOT OFFER 2+ times branch's DUE-PRACTITIONER JUSTIFICATION must fire. PASS if the agent's offer names exactly the two times 9:00 AM and 10:30 AM, names Sarah, names the location on this first offer, AND includes a one-sentence justification tying the recommendation to what the caller said (e.g. 'based on what you've told me, Sarah is a good match for this') in the SAME turn as the time offer -- with zero tool call this turn (it's an offer, not a booking). FAIL if the offer omits the justification sentence entirely, if it names a third time or a second band, or if it makes a tool call this turn.

scenarios.name: no-justification-when-caller-names-practitioner

history.content: I'd like to book Sarah Chen for my knee pain, I'm a new patient.

DYNAMIC VARIABLES: {{caller_complaint}}='knee pain', {{new_patient_allocation_enabled}}='true', {{patient_status}}='new', {{appointment_type}}='Physiotherapy', {{appointment_type_id}}='9001', {{practitioner_services}}='Sarah Chen=Physiotherapy|Mark Lee=Physiotherapy', {{practitioners_with_ids}}='Sarah Chen:5501, Mark Lee:5502'

history.text: When would you like to come in?

history.content: TOOL RESULT (smart_voice_agent intent=availability, this is the FIRST availability result of the call): {"practitioners": [{"practitioner_name": "Sarah Chen", "practitioner_id": "5501", "business_name": "Ryde Natural Health", "business_id": "5", "dates": [{"date": "2026-09-16", "slot_groups": {"morning": ["9:00 AM", "9:30 AM", "10:00 AM", "10:30 AM"]}, "slot_offer": {"morning": {"count": 4, "first": "9:00 AM", "last": "10:30 AM", "truncated": true, "middle": ["9:30 AM", "10:00 AM"]}}}], "bands_available": ["morning"]}], "multi_day": false}

scenarios.expected_behavior: The caller named Sarah Chen themselves in their very first message, so confirmed_practitioner was set by PRACTITIONER PREFERENCE's own name resolution BEFORE this search ran -- PRACTITIONER + LOCATION FALLBACK's own trigger ('confirmed_practitioner was not already set') never applies here even though caller_complaint, new_patient_allocation_enabled, and patient_status all still qualify. PASS if the agent offers 9:00 AM or 10:30 AM with Sarah at the location, on the first offer of the call, with NO justification sentence added. FAIL if the agent adds any justification-style sentence (e.g. 'Sarah is a good match for this', 'based on what you've told me') to this offer -- the caller chose Sarah themselves, so there is nothing to justify.
